title: Solana Foundation president says crypto gaming is dead

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Crypto gaming is dead, says Solana Foundation president — really?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This claim is sparking huge debate on Reddit with 157 points and 49 comments.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Solana’s president claims crypto gaming can’t sustain long-term value or user interest.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Solana’s blockchain is being used for high-speed transactions in gaming, but adoption is low.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects gamers and developers relying on blockchain for in-game economies.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key issue? Scalability and real-world utility are still missing in most crypto games.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think — is crypto gaming really dead, or just evolving?

caption_text: Solana Foundation president says crypto gaming is dead
